subject: alice-meadows
label: Alice's hell had a name and it was Torie
from: Unknown. The Archive knew only that CIVILIAN did not mean unharmed
to: NOT BEING ABLE TO PROTECT TORIE. In high school, and then through the therapy years after
note:
SHE DIDN'T GET OUT OF HELL, SHE HAD HER OWN — and it was not a place. It was a FAILURE TO PROTECT, twice over, across years.

FIRST IN HIGH SCHOOL, when a football team coerced a boy called Luke into hurting the queer after practice and Alice could not stop it. She punched Bryn repeatedly in that doorway and then carried Torie away, and none of that was enough, because it had already happened.

AND THEN AGAIN AFTERWARD — THROUGH THE THERAPY YEARS — when Torie was doing the slow, unglamorous work of surviving what had been done to her, and there was NOTHING FOR ALICE TO PUNCH. That is the second hell and it is the longer one. You cannot stand between someone and their own recovery.

WHICH REWRITES HER ENTIRE PRESENT. Alice Meadows plates a smaller portion for the raccoon. Alice wrote the menus for a fleet of aftercare carts, deciding what a wrecked girl is offered at two in the morning. ALICE IS THE OLDER SISTER, THE CHAOS GUARDIAN, KNIFE-IN-HEELS. Every one of those is the same woman building systems that protect people ON THE DAYS SHE IS NOT IN THE ROOM — because the thing that broke her was being the person who was not enough, in the room, twice.

And she is twenty-eight, and has been for four years.
